area: Printer Friendly Work Orders - Print Option in More Menu
title: Print is disabled until line item data has loaded
permissions_required: View Work Order (no new permission introduced)
preconditions: In the top menu click “Work Orders”, then open a work order (click its row) to reach its detail view. You have permission to view it. (Route drafted from the spec and marked PROVISIONAL — confirm the exact toolbar/labels on the build.)
steps: Open the work order and open the More menu while line item data is still loading (or when no line items exist).
Observe the Print item as the UI skeleton appears and then as the real data arrives.
expected:
1. The Print option is disabled (grayed out and non-clickable) until line item data has finished loading, and while no line items exist.
2. It does not enable when only the UI skeleton appears — it waits for the actual data to arrive.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9383 and story SV-9384 (Story 1, Print Option in More Menu) and the Printer Friendly Work Orders specification version 8, section S1-E1, read on 25 August 2026.
